authoring.author: claude (de-baarsjes-faces lane)
authoring.note: Jan Evertsenstraat 89A-135 (odd side, Hoofdweg to the Mercatorplein passage). The hood-lisene row 93-129 (evertsen-1926-hood-lisene): box frames by the lisenes on every other party wall (none on 93-99), the party-wall windows completed by mirrored neighbours (bayFill), the glass-block band over the canopy; the stepped corner 89A-91, the 121-125 mass in modules, and the plain 133-135.
